provenance.notes: Clean-room placeholder signup acknowledgement from the observed POST /cgi-bin/dmBsignup.cgi on digi_b.wgg.channel.or.jp. Request body semantics and original account content remain unknown. HTTP client ROM 3B0659 checks a status-line length of at least 12, then accepts ASCII '2' following the scanned space at 3B0898; it does not validate every status digit. The authored response is 200 OK with Content-Length: 9. Wrapper 3F7D3D finds CRLFCRLF within its first 256 scan positions. Game fields use DS=0C00: first body byte at DS:3814 is physical RAM 0F814, distinct from adapter fields under DS=0000. Phase 8 comparisons at 3F8D45 and following branches select the registering path for the tested body byte 00. The 01/FF message-only alternatives and 301/302 redirects are static findings, not exercised features. There is no body-length check before copying eight ID bytes from body+1 to DS:3A17 (physical 0FA17); nine bytes is our safe reply contract. Native flag DS:3A0C (physical 0FA0C) becomes 1 at 3F8D97; save call 3F8D9C enters writer 3BDF4C, which stores the flag at EEPROM 066E and the ID at 0679..0680. Body 00 and M32PLACE are authored placeholders shared by requests. Prepared eligibility/title/editor context is required; result-screen artifacts remain, and a save-reloaded registered menu is readable. No natural signup entry, ranking, friend, data or battle feature is claimed.
